# Implementation Plan: Homepage Header Redesign

**Branch**: `001-homepage-header-redesign` | **Date**: 2026-05-02 | **Spec**: [spec.md](spec.md)
**Input**: Feature specification from `specs/001-homepage-header-redesign/spec.md`

**Note**: This plan was generated by the `/speckit.plan` command.

## Summary

Redesign the Chef Book homepage hero/header section from a 300×300 square photo layout to a **full-width cinematic banner** with a 21:9 aspect ratio (16:9 on mobile). The hero image becomes the dominant visual element spanning the full content width, with the "Chef Book" title and "Featured Chef" badge overlaid using glassmorphism styling. All existing interactive features (image zoom, refresh rotation) are preserved. Implementation is CSS-only with minimal HTML restructuring.

## Technical Context

**Language/Version**: HTML5, CSS3, ES6+ JavaScript  
**Primary Dependencies**: None new — vanilla frontend per Constitution Principle I  
**Storage**: N/A — frontend-only change, no database impact  
**Testing**: Manual visual testing + browser DevTools responsive mode  
**Target Platform**: Web (PWA via Vite + Capacitor Android wrapper)  
**Project Type**: Web application (frontend component)  
**Performance Goals**: 60fps CSS animations, no layout shift on load  
**Constraints**: Must work on viewports 320px–2400px+, RTL support required  
**Scale/Scope**: Single page component (homepage hero section only)

## Design Direction

### Current State
- 300×300px square image with rounded corners
- Image wrapped in `hero-content` flex container with column layout
- "Featured Chef" badge positioned absolutely above the image
- "Chef Book" title overlaid at bottom-left of the image
- Glassmorphism background on `hero-content` container
- Max-width: 2400px container with 20px padding

### New State: Full-Width Cinematic Banner
- **Image**: Full content-width with 21:9 aspect ratio (cinematic ultrawide)
- **Image container**: Rounded corners (32px), slight border glow, no fixed width/height
- **Title overlay**: Large "Chef Book" h1 positioned at bottom-left with gradient text
- **Badge**: "Featured Chef" pill badge at top-left of image
- **Gradient overlay**: Left-to-transparent gradient for text legibility
- **Refresh button**: Top-right, appears on hover (already works this way)
- **Zoom**: Click-to-fullscreen retained as-is
- **Mobile (≤992px)**: Image switches to 16:9 aspect ratio, badge/title scale down
- **Animations**: Existing entrance animations preserved and enhanced

### Visual Changes Summary

| Element | Before | After |
|---------|--------|-------|
| Image dimensions | 300×300px fixed | Full-width, 21:9 aspect ratio |
| Image shape | Square, 32px radius | Wide rectangle, 32px radius |
| Container padding | 80px 40px (hero-content) | 0 (image fills container) |
| Hero-content background | Dark glassmorphism panel | Transparent (removed) |
| Title position | Bottom-left of image | Bottom-left of image (larger) |
| Badge position | Top-center above image | Top-left inside image |
| Mobile image | 200×200px | Full-width, 16:9 aspect ratio |
